notes.manas-2010:p1068:b001:l003: Чоң-Бээжин Great Beijing distinguished from Tüp/Deep and Chet/Outer Beijing; epic geography not mapped onto modern administrative borders.
notes.manas-2010:p1068:b001:l004: Six-month journey retained, although subsequent pregnancy chronology is inconsistent.
notes.manas-2010:p1068:b001:l010: Tea-supplying town rendered from Чай алган кент; no unsupported identification with a modern town.
notes.manas-2010:p1068:b001:l012: Желиндеген mare with swollen udder, indicating advanced pregnancy in context; no veterinary precision inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1068:b001:l020: Жагоо neck ornament/collar here, as attached to the mare; exact construction uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1068:b001:l022: Manas is the addressee, not one of the two receiving identical care; those two are Altynay and the mare.
notes.manas-2010:p1068:b001:l028: Кара сан upper/fleshy thigh; кара intensifies rather than specifying dark skin.
notes.manas-2010:p1068:b001:l031: Six days unable to give birth repeated at:l034; both retained as epic narration.
notes.manas-2010:p1068:b001:l035: Fly-like soul retains the conventional image of fragile life.
notes.manas-2010:p1068:b001:l040: Mazhik who came with me refers to the speaker’s later journey to the present audience, not a newly narrated arrival during the birth.
notes.manas-2010:p1069:b001:l001: Кожо pious elder in epic usage, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кожо/; translated title rather than left as an unexplained common noun. No genealogy from the caliphs asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1069:b001:l003: Kalcha established epithet of Kongurbay, not a separate new attacker; local glossary1838:l030 defines formidable/fierce with physical-description alternative.
notes.manas-2010:p1069:b001:l006: Six years old at capture, seventeen at childbirth episode:l011, both retained; no chronological reconciliation.
notes.manas-2010:p1069:b001:l019: Ыймандаш fellowship in faith and funerary solidarity, rather than a newly invented biological relationship.
notes.manas-2010:p1069:b001:l022: Kök-Bulung treated provisionally as a place name from repeated directional/forest setting; literally blue/green corner or inlet.
notes.manas-2010:p1069:b001:l023: Kögala mount named as printed; not harmonized with another character’s later horse of that name.
notes.manas-2010:p1069:b001:l041: Алмам familiar form of Almambet retained as name; exact God-made-me construction compressed, no alternative divine title invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1070:b001:l001: Pierced ears and already-circumcised birth are the speaker’s miraculous birth claims, reproduced without treating them as verified medical history.
notes.manas-2010:p1070:b001:l004: A black snake separating at birth is retained literally; whether an attendant spirit or an image of afterbirth is not established.
notes.manas-2010:p1070:b001:l007: Blood pours from both hands as printed, not silently changed to clotted blood held in the hands.
notes.manas-2010:p1070:b001:l011: Seventy days of rain and earthquake retained as epic portents.
notes.manas-2010:p1070:b001:l025: Таятам is specifically maternal grandfather. Soorondük raw Соорондүкка spelling retained in provenance.
notes.manas-2010:p1070:b001:l030: Буттап pood-weight measure of gold; unit retained without exact-count or metric conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p1070:b001:l035: Nine months here follows three months of rearing and prior nine-month pregnancy; sequence is preserved rather than rationalized.
notes.manas-2010:p1071:b001:l002: Калдай governor, established dictionary rank gloss. Dark-roaming description may attach to governor rather than mother; English leaves the preceding fragment detached.
notes.manas-2010:p1071:b001:l003: Blue robe can describe the suspected monk father rather than the mother. Fragment retained without an invented subject.
notes.manas-2010:p1071:b001:l011: Арам сийдик literally illegitimate/impure urine; harsh bastard-piss insult preserved as quoted speech.
notes.manas-2010:p1071:b001:l014: Даңзачы record-keeper, used here to count marriage dates; no exact historical bureaucratic office claimed.
notes.manas-2010:p1071:b001:l024: Spring flowing in a valley is the child metaphor, not an added geographic episode.
notes.manas-2010:p1071:b001:l039: Жетимиш жылдык literally of seventy years, unlike seventy days at1073:l010. Literal wording retained with uncertainty about commemorative age versus feast magnitude/duration.
notes.manas-2010:p1071:b001:l041: First-person waist bending as silk abruptly interrupts feast narration; retained rather than converted to a third-person adult gesture.
notes.manas-2010:p1072:b001:l008: Мапы two-wheeled Chinese carriage positively defined with this exact verse in Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/мапы/.
notes.manas-2010:p1072:b001:l015: Lap placement and later lifting are both retained; exact handover sequence compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p1072:b001:l031: Place and submission clauses remain on respective source lines031–032; magical well allegedly distinguishes future allegiance.
notes.manas-2010:p1072:b001:l039: Бериште angel, ordinary phonetic variant; no named angel supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1072:b001:l042: Үзүк yurt roof-felt comparison retained, not generic unqualified cloud.
notes.manas-2010:p1073:b001:l007: Thinking of dying has an unexpressed subject: Karykan’s own mortality or fear for the child are possible. English avoids assigning the death to one person.
notes.manas-2010:p1073:b001:l012: Oybo and Shoybo are proposed personal names explicitly rejected in the source, not untranslated whole utterances.
notes.manas-2010:p1073:b001:l027: Ырымдуу ritually portentous/superstitious in hostile reaction; ominous contextual interpretation, not a separate accusation of a specified spell.
notes.manas-2010:p1073:b001:l032: Alake affectionate self-reference to Almambet, not an additional character.
notes.manas-2010:p1073:b001:l039: Бутка idol attached at the neck, not a foot; introduced Buddhist object preserved without identification of deity.
notes.manas-2010:p1073:b001:l040: Sixty stepmothers retained, not reduced to one mother or combined with earlier forty-wife traditions.
notes.manas-2010:p1074:b001:l002: Кунан horse in its third year/two years completed; translated two-year-old, racing action куушкан remains compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p1074:b001:l005: Same birth day for horse and rider as printed despite mare’s birth being told after the naming feast.
notes.manas-2010:p1074:b001:l013: Асый fully mature horse, five years or older; no exact horse age silently inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1074:b001:l015: Burut is the source exonym for Kyrgyz, retained as established terminology.
notes.manas-2010:p1074:b001:l017: Unlawful food indicated retrospectively by speaker; no specific meat invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1074:b001:l035: Алган жерим literally land I gained, retained; dispossession/restoration is supplied by later Kan-Zhaylak story, not silently inserted here.
notes.manas-2010:p1074:b001:l042: Averden lake as spelled, without harmonization to other witnesses or modern geography.
notes.manas-2010:p1075:b001:l006: Жай here weather/rain magic, not simply summer. Dragon’s magical curriculum distinguished from modern education.
notes.manas-2010:p1075:b001:l009: Күрмө short outer coat; gold-wrought claim retained as epic material, not asserted modern armor specification.
notes.manas-2010:p1075:b001:l014: Билип rule/administer in context, possible shortened бийлеп; raw not changed.
notes.manas-2010:p1075:b001:l038: Golden айдар interpreted as forelock ornament; exact wearer/subject of following swing ambiguous, no additional character named.
notes.manas-2010:p1076:b001:l015: Seven survivors provisionally inclusive of speaker, consistent with six/eight/nine/ten sequence; compressed Жети бала, мен калдым could be read seven plus me.
notes.manas-2010:p1076:b001:l023: Nine thousand perish then nine remain; apparent total-versus-survivor contradiction retained, as at026–027.
notes.manas-2010:p1076:b001:l034: Three additional months of study as printed.
notes.manas-2010:p1076:b001:l040: Казыналык treasury/state-maintained marksman, no modern ministry or military rank inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1077:b001:l002: Кесик protracted illness positively defined in2015 dictionary with Kozhozhash epic citation https://el-sozduk.kg/кесик/. No specific diagnosis invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1077:b001:l017: Gendered insult retained: making adversaries whimper as girls; no literal magical sex change asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1077:b001:l019: Суп fine white fabric in epic usage, silk or white camel hair per Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/суп/. Exact fiber unspecified in English.
notes.manas-2010:p1077:b001:l021: Арып/арыбын spell or magical art in curriculum context, not alphabet letters or fatigue.
notes.manas-2010:p1077:b001:l028: Boiled brine retained literally in parallel with dug pit; metaphorical trouble/ordeal, no invented historical torture method.
notes.manas-2010:p1078:b001:l011: Elephant hide could cover scabbard/haft rather than the cutting blade; source does not specify attachment, so none added.
notes.manas-2010:p1078:b001:l013: Түпөк tuft attached at weapon head, local glossary1843:l006. Sword description includes spear-like fitting; not silently changed into spear.
notes.manas-2010:p1078:b001:l022: Корт этме brittle, primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/корт/. Yellow glue soaking retained literally in next line, not factual metallurgical advice.
notes.manas-2010:p1078:b001:l028: Ал strength here paired with алым at027, not the demonstrative he.
notes.manas-2010:p1078:b001:l033: Kan-Zhaylak named land sought from Kongurbay; not a second khan character.
notes.manas-2010:p1079:b001:l011: Жалаңкыч death-bringing/soul-taking demon,1969 and2015 dictionaries https://el-sozduk.kg/жалаңкыч/.
notes.manas-2010:p1079:b001:l015: Төр upper valley/spacious place in forehead comparison; exact sense uncertain, retained as terrain image.
notes.manas-2010:p1079:b001:l020: Thousand governors is source hyperbole; not silently translated into ordinary soldiers.
notes.manas-2010:p1079:b001:l034: Укурук кайрар literally turning/raising a herding pole, contextual resistance to Kalcha; not a specified spear action.
notes.manas-2010:p1080:b001:l028: Kongurbay says killed me before my time while alive; quoted hyperbole preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1080:b001:l036: Ой бербейт leave no repose/room to think contextual reading; possible printed ой versus ordinary бой formulation not silently repaired.
notes.manas-2010:p1081:b001:l007: Токуп saddled, repeated weapon/horse preparation wording, not learning unless changed source supported; next two lines explicitly describe learning dragon languages.
notes.manas-2010:p1081:b001:l033: Калдай governor used collectively among ethnonyms. Peculiar governors’ khanship retained, no invented tribe name.
notes.manas-2010:p1081:b001:l034: Ылама lama as title here; Great Lama later may act as personal designation. Not confused with unrelated Islamic scholar улама.
notes.manas-2010:p1081:b001:l040: Төбөңдөн тийген curse with omitted agent retained, no explicit divine punishment invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1082:b001:l001: Not yet twelve contradicts speaker’s repeatedly stated twelve; retained as Esenkan’s belittling speech.
notes.manas-2010:p1082:b001:l011: Шумбул a Chinese administrative rank, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/шумбул/. Таш stone worn as an apparent insignia; exact badge, material and rank unverified. Literal official’s stone retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1082:b001:l012: Жарым кан lesser/partial khan, not a statement of biological half-parentage.
notes.manas-2010:p1082:b001:l014: Ташсынып treating stone as stone/scorning it; exact nuance provisional. No silent emendation of repeated таш to тон coat.
notes.manas-2010:p1082:b001:l029: Sarala’s fullness/well-fed state treated as an obstacle; no unmentioned injury or fatigue substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1083:b001:l001: Explicit under-twelve age retained; ensuing unwanted touch and refusal described plainly without added sexual detail.
notes.manas-2010:p1083:b001:l024: Бурулуш жер turning/diverging place retained as vague geographic direction; no named refuge invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1083:b001:l029: Religious dark/clean contrast is Burulcha’s quoted polemic, retained without asserting narrator endorsement.
notes.manas-2010:p1083:b001:l033: Binding hair retained, no unsupported specific marriage hairstyle or vow duration supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1083:b001:l040: Магшар resurrection/Judgment Day; tomorrow has eschatological rather than calendar precision.
notes.manas-2010:p1084:b001:l001: Son/daughter of light religious imagery, not siblings of a person named Nur.
notes.manas-2010:p1084:b001:l004: Sitting/stopping phrase retained literally; possible prayer posture implication not stated as certain.
notes.manas-2010:p1084:b001:l006: Bare tethering ground metaphor retained as insult, not a missing place name.
notes.manas-2010:p1084:b001:l021: Кир сөз dirty/defiling word retained from Almambet’s then-hostile perspective toward conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p1084:b001:l031: Burulcha stops speaking as printed; not silently changed to Almambet or a completed reconciliation.
notes.manas-2010:p1084:b001:l041: Masculine epithet provisionally attaches to Esenkan across page boundary; could be a stock displaced description. Raw sequence retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1085:b001:l010: Letting horse belly empty/lean down retained as conditioning after earlier excessive fullness, not disembowelment.
notes.manas-2010:p1085:b001:l014: Captivity then escape preserved although how the capture happened is not described.
notes.manas-2010:p1085:b001:l031: Great Lama title used as designation of Kalmyk champion, literal rendering rather than unverified new personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p1085:b001:l037: Алкым throat/narrow passage, contextual approach route; no precise topographical identification asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1085:b001:l038: Канжаркол dagger-handed fighters as group, supported by Manas encyclopedia account of trained Chinese troop type https://el-sozduk.kg/КАН/. Not automatically the separate character bearing same name.
notes.manas-2010:p1086:b001:l004: Тойбой literally unsatisfied retained; possible койбой not leaving defect not silently adopted.
notes.manas-2010:p1086:b001:l014: Sixty wives called mothers collectively, not counted as sixty plus one from singular энем.
notes.manas-2010:p1086:b001:l018: Did not see tears carries ignored-them force, without literal blindness claimed.
notes.manas-2010:p1086:b001:l025: Кембайлап tightly bound in repeated captive-driving formula. Exact binding arrangement remains unverified; no invented shackles material.
notes.manas-2010:p1086:b001:l039: Death of all sixty mothers explicitly arrives as rumor, preserved before speaker’s reaction; not independent historical fact.
notes.manas-2010:p1087:b001:l006: Cow-rumped horse conformation epithet retained, not an assertion horse is a cow.
notes.manas-2010:p1087:b001:l015: Убал жок no pity/protection if failing vengeance, conditional self-curse; does not absolve responsibility for slaughter.
notes.manas-2010:p1087:b001:l030: Muhammad’s community blessing explains west-facing door in quoted belief; light narrative retained without external theological claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1087:b001:l033: Теңир Heaven/divine power in Islamic context; no separate deity biography added.

publication_basis: New English draft directly translated from Kyrgyz traditional folklore, no prior English poem translation input. Two whole lines explicitly unresolved and excluded from English count. No independent expert review or complete-witness claim.
